messages:
sara: CI on main is red for macOS after the recent toolchain roll — looks like pkg-config deps are missing. Anyone else seeing this? https://ci.redwood.io/builds/12345 :exclamation:

ci-bot: Build failed: build/12345 macos-clang - logs: https://ci.redwood.io/builds/12345/log

devon: I can reproduce locally with the new image. CMake complains about PkgConfig and then libuv/libpq missing. Paste of the key error below:

```
-- Could NOT find PkgConfig (missing: PKG_CONFIG_EXECUTABLE)
CMake Error at cmake/FindLibuv.cmake:12 (message):
  libuv not found via pkg-config
-- Configuring incomplete, errors occurred!
```

kai: My hunch: the toolchain image bumped OS libs and dropped pkg-config from PATH (or switched package layout). There was a toolchain-image PR 9a1f2c earlier today that moved from gcc12->gcc13. Might be related. Suggest a quick bisect if rerun doesn't help.

marco: For a quick workaround we can add a CMake fallback to use vendored cmake/modules if pkg-config not present. Example patch: 

```diff
+find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)
+if(NOT PKG_CONFIG_FOUND)
+  message(WARNING "PkgConfig not found; falling back to vendored config.")
+  list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/modules")
+endif()
```

sara: Good idea. Before changing source, can we rerun CI with the legacy toolchain image to confirm? @devon can you trigger a rerun with LABEL=toolchain:legacy?

devon: Yep — started rerun as build/12346 with the legacy image, watching logs now.

ci-bot: Rerun started: https://ci.redwood.io/builds/12346

ci-bot: Rerun finished: build/12346 SUCCESS (legacy toolchain image)

sara: OK that narrows it to the new toolchain image. Plan: 1) open PR with the CMake fallback so builds don't break instantly; 2) ask infra to pin the image for a short window while we bisect; 3) infra to bisect the toolchain image change. Assigning @marco to the PR and @devon to ping infra.

marco: I'll open the PR today and add an integration check that fails CI if pkg-config is missing (so we catch this earlier).

kai: I'll coordinate the bisect with infra tomorrow. Could be a packaging change in the distro layers.

sara: Thanks all — leaving a note on issue #2345 and will follow up on the infra pin. :white_check_mark:
